mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.board_code, b.board_name, b.department_id, d.department_name, b.active, b.created_at FROM board b LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = b.department_id ORDER BY b.board_id

SELECT b.board_id, b.board_code, b.board_name, b.department_id, d.department_name, b.active, b.created_at FROM board b LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = b.department_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}

SELECT b.board_id, b.board_code, b.board_name, b.department_id, d.department_name, b.active, b.created_at FROM board b LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = b.department_id WHERE b.active = 1 AND (b.department_id IS NULL OR b.department_id = #{departmentId} ) ORDER BY b.board_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (board_code, board_name, department_id, active) VALUES (#{boardCode}, #{boardName}, #{departmentId}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET active = 0 WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
